data.title: Chip Stocks Wipe Out $1 Trillion in Friday Bloodbath: 5 Stocks Alone Account for 60% of the Damage
data.description: Intel's worst day since 1974 drags chip stocks down about $1 trillion, with Nvidia, Intel, AMD, TSMC and Broadcom behind 60% of the losses.

data.title: Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile Could One Day Make Mobile Internet Free, Wireless Pioneer Says
data.description: Wireless pioneer Ray Dolan says carriers could one day make mobile internet free by earning revenue from cell-tower sensing data.

data.title: Black Friday Came Early for Chipmakers: Intel and 10 Other Stocks Are More Than 20% Off This Month
data.description: Intel and 10 other chip stocks, from Cerebras to Marvell, have lost more than 20% in October, yet 10 of the 11 remain up for 2026. SOXX is down 16.5%.
